gaps.question: Database issued_at is 2026-09-06 and revision is “submital set,” while visible sheets are dated 2023, many are marked “SD PROGRESS 06/27/23,” and all visible title blocks state “NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.” Which human-controlled issue/revision governs field use?

Sprinkler statements conflict: A-0II says Sprinkler YES and A-001 note 24 requires an automatic residential fire-sprinkler system, while A-002 Fire Department note 1 says fire sprinklers are not required. Obtain written clarification before activating sprinkler capture scope.

The embedded Grading Pre-Inspection Report is for the same address but describes a “NEW 4-STORY MULTIFAMILY RESIDENTIAL BUILDING,” while the plan set describes a 2-story single-family dwelling. Confirm whether this report belongs to the project and whether a superseding grading/soils record exists.

Area statements conflict: 3,662 sf floor area on A-0II, 4,485 sq ft on A-010/A-011, and 3,965 conditioned floor area in the T24 report. Human review must identify what each area includes before baseline activation.
Lot area is printed as 5,000 sf on A-0II/A-007 but 4,999 sq ft on A-110. Confirm the controlling survey/site value.
Visible title blocks use project numbers 2306-NA and 1507-GS. Confirm that both numbering systems belong to this same project and identify the document-control relationship.

A complete framing_wall register could not be created conservatively: the floor plan has many printed dimension strings, but wall runs are not uniquely labelled and the relationship between architectural wall types, structural wood framing and A-810 metal-stud details is unresolved. Human markup must uniquely label each wall run; lengths must then be copied only from printed dimensions, with no scaling.
Door schedule and plan tags support opening widths, but the wall-run assignment of each opening must be reconciled before openings can be attached to framing_wall records.

The supplied high-resolution view of S-3 is cropped at the right and bottom. Exact drawn counts for FB, HDR, F.J., D.J., hold-down and strap marks require reconciliation with the complete-page reading or the other chunk.

Marks HDU4, HDU5, HDU8, MST48, MST60, MST72, HST2 and HST5 are visible on plans, but their complete schedule/specification rows were not visible in this chunk. Reconcile against S-4 through S-9 in the other chunk before final member reporting.

Two “SSW 12x9” marks are visible at isolated foundation conditions, but the strong-wall schedule/detail is not visible in this chunk. Resolve the mark and confirm the drawn count against the complete plan.

D.J.1 is scheduled as 2x10 #2 @16” O.C., but a framed exterior deck/platform with unambiguous printed overall dimensions, area, decking and guardrail information was not established. Do not populate framing_decks until the mark and architectural platform are reconciled.

A-810 prints metal-stud backing, nested jamb studs, straps and track details that are not represented cleanly by the wood-framing takeoff fields. Human review should retain these printed members/details in the scope record rather than silently omit them.

Architectural notes reference Civil LID plans and a RainFlo 7,000-gallon, 8-foot-diameter tank, but those civil sheets are not listed in the supplied database register. Confirm whether they are a separate controlled document set before using the stormwater route as installation scope.

The second-floor wet area is labelled BATH 3 24 in part of the plan while the room-number sequence and parsed room list are inconsistent. Reconcile the exact room name/number before creating a space or room-specific task for that area.
Component schedule rows are transcribed below, but exact tile-by-tile drawn counts should be independently reviewed because the floor-plan tags are dense and several plan tags overlap leaders.
The visible structural sheets are prominently marked “NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION” and “SD PROGRESS 06/27/23.” Which human-reviewed, construction-authorized revision governs field activation?

Database metadata identifies revision “submital set” and issued_at 2026-09-06, while visible sheets show date 11/10/2023 and issue “SD PROGRESS 06/27/23.” Resolve the revision and issue-date conflict before activation.
Database discipline is architectural, but pages 26-30 are structural sheets S-4 through S-8. Confirm the controlled discipline classification for the unified source register.
